title: Harness EventLogger span
description: One append-only span per line in events.jsonl. Same conceptual fields as LangSmith / Langfuse traces; the harness owns the local trail.

event_type.description: Span name, e.g. PERMISSION_GRANTED, WRITE_FILE_SUCCESS, PATH_TRAVERSAL_BLOCKED

session_id.description: Run / session id shared by all spans in one harness execution

details.description: Tool name, path, allow/deny, latency_ms, token usage, redacted inputs/outputs
